panels.title: Fleet Health — Failure Probability
panels.description: Mean P(failure_48h) across all pumps. Red line at alert threshold 0.7.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field == "score")
  |> group(columns: ["pump_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Fleet PSI — Data Drift
panels.description: Max PSI across all pumps per feature. Red line at significant threshold 0.25.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field =~ /psi_.*/)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Alert State
panels.description: Pumps currently in alert state (PSI > 0.25 or score > 0.7). Literal passthrough — no re-derived thresholds.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field == "score")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["pump_id"])
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field =~ /psi_.*/)
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["pump_id"])
  |> max()

panels.title: Pumps Reporting
panels.description: Count of distinct pump_ids with data in the last 5 minutes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field == "score")
  |> group(columns: ["pump_id"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Max Fleet Score
panels.description: Highest P(failure_48h) across the fleet right now.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field == "score")
  |> group()
  |> max()

panels.title: Max Fleet PSI
panels.description: Highest PSI value across all pumps and features right now.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field =~ /psi_.*/)
  |> group()
  |> max()

panels.title: Alerts Active
panels.description: Number of pumps currently breaching PSI > 0.25 or score > 0.7.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pump_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pump_telemetry" and r._field == "score")
  |> group(columns: ["pump_id"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.7)
  |> count()
